title: Authorized WI-08 content-bound evidence reuse successor
rawUserRequest: Complete the approved WI-08 content-bound evidence reuse Work Item after its archived branch collided on archive sequence 917. Redeliver the same bounded behavior from the current remote main, preserve predecessor evidence byte-for-byte, and continue the full Work Item lifecycle.

declaredIntent.summary: Redeliver only the WI-08 content-bound reuse policy on current main after a governed archive-sequence collision.

outOfScope: Rewriting, deleting, rebasing, or renumbering the predecessor WI-08 archive, its outcome, its summary, or PR #853.
Changing the WI-07 evidence-binding schema or foundation semantics.
Implementing WI-09 diff-bound or WI-10 environment-bound policy behavior.
Changing ai_verify, required-check execution, scheduler, cache, retry, provider, CI, network, or gate authority.
Granting reuse for unknown, malformed, expired, scope-mismatched, governance-mismatched, or content-mismatched evidence.

acceptance: The successor is created from the exact current origin/main commit and a canonical conflict-successor receipt binds source, successor, Issue #854, authority, reason, and immutable predecessor evidence.

A pure API builds deterministic content identity from non-empty repository-relative POSIX paths and exact bytes using sorted length-and-payload framing; unsafe, duplicate, empty, or non-byte inputs fail closed.

A content-bound decision returns fresh/reuse only when content digest, exact path set, security scope, governance policy, and freshness match; unrelated base changes do not invalidate identical content.

Missing, malformed, unknown, expired, classification-mismatched, scope-mismatched, governance-mismatched, or content-mismatched inputs return unknown or stale with action=rerun and stable reasons; no gate authority is granted.
Focused tests cover deterministic identity, base-independent exact reuse, path/content mismatch, unsafe inputs, unknown/malformed/expired cases, policy boundaries, and caller immutability.

The file docs/reference/content-bound-evidence-reuse.md contains the input, canonicalization, fail-closed, and non-integration rules; all 16 local checks plus hosted PR checks pass before archive, merge, and ai-close-work-item.
guidelines: Preserve predecessor archives and failed PR evidence byte-for-byte; use the canonical successor transition receipt.
Compare exact canonical content, path, security scope, governance, and freshness identities; never infer equivalence from branches, timestamps, or self-report.
Fail closed to rerun for unknown, malformed, stale, mismatched, or out-of-scope evidence.
Keep the policy pure and local; existing verification runners retain authority to execute every required check.
Use locked repository format and lint tools and record generated projections through their owning commands.

intent.problem: The original WI-08 archive allocated sequence 917 from a divergent base and cannot be merged because current main already owns sequence 917 for WI-09. Direct rebase would rewrite immutable evidence.
constraints: The user's 2026-08-16 approval permits all necessary successor Work Items to complete the approved plan.
Preserve predecessor WI-08 archive, summary, outcome, manifest, and PR #853 byte-for-byte; do not add new product scope.
Start from current origin/main, bind the canonical transition to Issue #854, and keep WI-09/WI-10 boundaries unchanged.
Unknown, malformed, expired, or mismatched evidence must rerun and never bypass required gates.
intent.rationale: A clean, explicitly user-approved successor provides the same bounded behavior without mutating historical evidence or accepting an archive collision.
